notes: 4A simulation modifiers only. Values and simplified response formulas are provisional, not verified physics or final balance.

formulas.stacking: base * max(0, 1 + upgrade_bonus + research_bonus); each source applied once
formulas.temperature: target + (previous - target) * exp(-hours / legacy_cold_time_constant); target blends outside and heater set point by delivered power
formulas.power: allocate available generation plus stored energy in life-support, heater, greenhouse, miner, cleaning, repair order
formulas.event_timing: random event checks at each sol start, including sol zero; scripted events fire at their configured simulation hour
formulas.safety: pause on life-support power shortage, empty essential reserve, unsafe cold or radiation game limit; no crew death
